name: qfd_io_xfifo-cf1004f35-tt
purpose: TT-BATCH (owner option B, one large batch): qfd_io_xfifo-cf1004f35 re-routed at ORFS CORNER=TC (setup repair at TT), flow-hold mm FF hold HM 50, rule H1, CTS fix hooks + consistent die-link budget; original source commit kept; verdict TT setup >= 0 / FF hold >= 0 / DRC 0, SS = sensitivity. | was: Qwen r21 qfd_io_xfifo (400.008 x 1563.816): five credit CDC channels (UCIe/SerDes TX/RX, sequencer->collective); 4 unrelated clocks; route 770 / sign-off 833.333, 150 ps on every port

bench.name: cdc_ch_exact
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/cc0 -P tb_qwen_die_cdc_ch.NEG=0 rtl/test/tb_qwen_die_cdc_ch.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_cdc_ch.sv rtl/lib/ot_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/cc0 | tee {RUN}/bench/cc0.log && grep -q '^PASS' {RUN}/bench/cc0.log

bench.name: cdc_ch_neg
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/cc1 -P tb_qwen_die_cdc_ch.NEG=1 rtl/test/tb_qwen_die_cdc_ch.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_cdc_ch.sv rtl/lib/ot_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/cc1 | tee {RUN}/bench/cc1.log && grep -q '^PASS' {RUN}/bench/cc1.log

calibrate.reason: die-context IO is referenced IN-RUN to this block's own propagated clock (io_ref_skew.sdc measures the boundary-register arrival after CTS and re-applies at GRT/DRT/FILL), so no calibrated insertion feeds the SDC; no Qwen budget sheet exists (asked the die-top agent)

route.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; SRC={SRC} bash physical/qwen_die_masters/jobs/route_master.sh qfd_io_xfifo {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/hbm_fmax_attn_abstract.py --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --name qfd_io_xfifo --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_io_xfifo --image openroad/orfs:asap7lock  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: no Qwen r21 budget sheet; masters kit budgets (0.2 T outside + 90 ps intra / 150 ps inter-region, hold 50) applied in-run

cycles_added: CDC latency only on IO paths (async FIFO + credit faces, ~4-6 cycles a crossing); the collective all-reduce path crosses ck->serdes/ucie once each way: priced in the record as +12 core cycles per collective (upper bound)
